heading: Two formats. One goal: less DHT.
body: A provider-prescribed approach to male pattern hair loss - available as a once-daily oral finasteride tablet that may lower DHT by about 70%, or a compounded 5-active topical gel that targets the scalp locally with potentially lower systemic exposure.*
activeIngredientsLabel: Active Ingredients: Finasteride. Available as a compounded topical formula (with Minoxidil, Tretinoin, Fluocinolone, Biotin) or FDA-approved oral tablet (Finasteride 1mg).

ingredients.name: Finasteride
ingredients.body: Type II 5-alpha reductase inhibitor. May lower DHT levels by approximately 70%.*

ingredients.name: Minoxidil (Topical)
ingredients.body: Included in the topical formula to stimulate blood flow to hair follicles and encourage hair growth and thickness.*

ingredients.name: Tretinoin (Topical)
ingredients.body: Included in the topical formula to enhance absorption of other active ingredients through the scalp.*

ingredients.name: Fluocinolone (Topical)
ingredients.body: Included in the topical formula to reduce scalp inflammation that can contribute to hair loss and follicle damage.*

safety.title: Common side effects
safety.body: Decreased libido, erectile dysfunction, decreased semen volume, breast tenderness or enlargement, and mood changes.

safety.title: Tell your healthcare provider
safety.body: Share any history of liver disease, prostate conditions, current prescriptions, and any plans for blood donation while on finasteride.

safety.title: Do not use if
safety.body: You are a woman or a child. Finasteride is a medication for men only. Women who are or may become pregnant should never handle finasteride-containing medications.

safety.title: Seek medical care
safety.body: Severe allergic reaction (rash, swelling, trouble breathing), persistent breast changes, severe mood changes, or signs of high-grade prostate disease.

disclaimer: All prescription medications require a valid and complete online consultation prior to approval and final pricing is determined. Compounded medications are not FDA-approved and have not been evaluated by the FDA for safety, effectiveness, or quality. A licensed provider may prescribe a compounded medication when they determine it is clinically appropriate for you.
Compounded Finasteride is not FDA-approved for hair loss in topical form. Statements regarding hair loss, hair growth, scalp health, and follicle support have not been evaluated by the FDA.
